recognize_zh: 淋巴結中倍切片中，一大片由嗜酸性白血球密集組成的鮮紅色區域（eosinophilic microabscess）位於濾泡間區，旁邊有淡色生發中心與小血管增生，是木村病淋巴結的典型組合。
features: Large sheet-like aggregate of eosinophils with bright red granular cytoplasm forming an eosinophilic microabscess
Adjacent reactive follicle with a pale germinal center (upper left)
Interfollicular areas with small lymphocytes and increased small vessels/high endothelial venules
No large atypical or Reed-Sternberg-like cells evident
Mixed background of lymphocytes and plasma cells
describe_en: Lymph node section shows a large, dense aggregate of eosinophils forming an eosinophilic microabscess in the interfollicular region. Adjacent areas show a reactive follicle with a pale germinal center and interfollicular small lymphocytes with increased small vessels. No large atypical cells are identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with Kimura lymphadenopathy in the appropriate clinical context.

ddx.vs: cHL contains CD30+/CD15+ Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells, which are not evident among the eosinophils here.
ALHE is a vascular proliferation lined by epithelioid endothelial cells in skin/subcutis, rather than nodal follicular hyperplasia with eosinophil abscesses.
LCH eosinophilic abscesses are accompanied by sinusoidal Langerhans cells with grooved nuclei positive for CD1a and langerin.
PTCL shows atypical medium-to-large T cells with effacement and aberrant phenotype rather than preserved reactive follicles.
